representation_fit.evidence: Brief's shape is physical spatial-workspace with canvas_object and '落位即意图': the app is a zoned SVG floor-plan canvas (source/app.js:18-23 ZONES) where an object's center-point position literally determines its zone membership (app.js:67-76), echoed by the side panel tag '摆放位置 = 分区归属' (index.html:56). Both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show 27 placed objects across 工作区/会议区/仓储区/展示区 plus an 未落位 corridor group (app.js:46).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Canvas occupies ~80% of the initial screen at both viewports; header tagline '落位即意图' (index.html:18); create affordances (type radiogroup + ＋新增, index.html:22-23) are in the top bar; ledger note states '不填表单，摆放即数据。拖拽与键盘操作完全等价' (index.html:57). Placement-as-data is the dominant visible task.

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: zone names, per-object labels (桌-01…椅-10), status-bar keyboard hints (index.html:69) and a one-sentence model explanation (index.html:57) are legible in both screenshots; no loading state — 27 objects render synchronously at startup (app.js:527-534), satisfying the brief's ready-at-load constraint.

navigation_cost.evidence: Structural: single screen, every object visible on load (both viewports). Reach any primary object in one step — Tab cycles selection (keys.js:30-31, app.js:360-369), direct canvas click (app.js:397-406), or ledger chip click (app.js:496-503). No modes, routes, or drills.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions mutate in place with immediate re-render: move (app.js:258-275), send-to-zone (app.js:277-294), add (app.js:296-307), duplicate/delete (app.js:311-338); pan/zoom preserve selection (app.js:414-424). Only overlay is the help sheet, Esc-dismissible with no state change (index.html:72-95, keys.js:16-19).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly: top bar (6-type seg, 新增, 吸附, 快捷键, 重置 — index.html:21-27), canvas, ledger, status bar (index.html:63-70), and three zoom buttons (index.html:46-50). Each maps to a required capability incl. the keyboard-equivalence seed; no redundant panels or extra modes.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, a11y.focus_order=skipped (measurement-summary.json). Positives: comprehensive keyboard equivalents (keys.js:25-69), aria-live toasts (index.html:51), aria-labels (index.html:22,32). Negatives: Tab is repurposed for object cycling (keys.js:30-31) removing native focus traversal on canvas, #app strips outline (styles.css:28) and styles.css has no :focus-visible rules; ledger chips are 11.5px font with 3px 8px padding (styles.css:137-142) consistent with the target-size fail.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass, and both screenshots are clean with no overlap or truncation. But 3 of 7 receipt checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size — the latter consistent with 11px SVG object labels at styles.css:91-94), implying a rework pass on contrast, hit-target and projected text sizes.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '空间操作有键盘等价物': keys.js covers arrows-move with snap-aware step and Shift big-step (keys.js:7-28), Tab/Shift+Tab cycle (30-31), D duplicate (36-38), Del delete (33-34), T type (46-47), [/] rotate 15° (49-50), 1-4 send-to-zone (52-55), N add (57-58), G snap (60-61), +/−/0 zoom (63-66); documented in the help overlay (index.html:78-93, explicitly stating the 验收基准 at :93) and asserted by a ?selftest=1 harness (keys.js:87-217). Success criterion 落位即意图 is implemented literally (app.js:67-76).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast: fail (receipt) — dim tokens --dim/--faint (styles.css:10-11) used for zone subtitles, notes, hints and object labels of unplaced items
a11y.target_size: fail (receipt) — ledger chips (styles.css:137-142) and segmented type buttons (styles.css:75) are small hit targets
type.min_projected_size: fail (receipt) — 11px SVG object labels (styles.css:91-94) project below minimum at both tested viewports
a11y.focus_order skipped in receipt; Tab hijacked for selection cycling (keys.js:30-31), #app outline removed (styles.css:28), no :focus-visible styles anywhere — keyboard focus path is unverified
missing_evidence: a11y.focus_order — check skipped in measurement-summary.json; no focus-order evidence available in blind package
scores.overall_note: impl-05 is a single-screen spatial floor-plan workbench that matches the brief nearly point for point: physical placement on a four-zone canvas is the data model itself (center-point membership, source/app.js:67-76), the create/place task dominates the initial screen at both 1280x860 and 1440x900, and the frozen acceptance seed — keyboard equivalence for every spatial operation — is implemented broadly in keys.js, surfaced in a help overlay, and even backed by an in-page self-test harness. Navigation cost and context loss are minimal because there is exactly one screen and every action re-renders in place, with initial data ready at load. The measurable weaknesses are accessibility and finish: the receipt fails a11y.contrast, a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size, and a11y.focus_order was skipped while the app repurposes Tab and strips outlines, leaving the keyboard focus path unverifiable. No layout defects are visible at either viewport. All judgments above are model-judged from screenshots, receipt, and source only; task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this pilot.
